title: Trip Protection Terms: Free Look Cancellation, Later Cancellation and Voiding
content:
A Trip Protection policy may be cancelled by the insured guest, and is voided by the system when the insured stay is cancelled by the host, declined or expires before confirmation.

## Terms

1. **Free look.** The guest may cancel a policy for a full premium refund only within the plan's free-look period of calendar days after purchase, and only when no claim has been submitted on the policy. The days are counted from the date part of the policy's purchase moment, and a cancellation on the last day stands. The purchase moment is the one on the system record of the policy being cancelled. A policy cancelled in this way shows the status cancelled in the free look, and its premium is refunded.
2. **Cancellation after the free look.** After the free-look period, cancelling refunds the plan's after-free-look refund percentage of the premium.
3. **Voiding.** A policy is voided, with the plan's void refund percentage of the premium refunded, when its stay is cancelled by the host, or is declined, or expires before confirmation. Voiding is done by the system, and the policy then shows the status voided.
4. **Guest cancellation of the stay.** A stay cancelled by the guest does not void the policy, because that cancellation may itself be a covered loss.

## Full refund under the free look: both conditions

| Cancelled on or before the last day of the free-look period | Claim submitted on the policy | Full premium refund under the free look |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |

## Boundary of the free-look period

For a plan whose free-look period is N calendar days and a policy bought on a given date, at any time of day:

- a cancellation dated the Nth calendar day after the purchase date is within the period, because a cancellation on the last day stands;
- a cancellation dated the following calendar day is after the free look.

On hypothetical dates with an illustrative period of 10 days: a policy bought at 21:30 on 5 May may be cancelled under the free look through 15 May; a cancellation on 16 May is after the free look.

## What happens to the policy when the stay ends early

| What the stay record shows | Effect on the policy |
|---|---|
| Cancelled by the host | Voided; void refund percentage of the premium refunded |
| Declined | Voided; void refund percentage of the premium refunded |
| Expired before confirmation | Voided; void refund percentage of the premium refunded |
| Cancelled by the guest | Not voided |
